incident-bot: ALERT: Deployment runtime-engine-usw2 showing repeated CrashLoopBackOffs (9 restarts in 7m). Severity: P1. Paging @alejandra

alejandra (oncall-sre): I'm awake. grabbing context. which clusters/nodes?

devin (eng-runtime): joining. We deployed runtime-engine v1.9.0 at 04:05 UTC with new TensorRT kernel chooser. Seeing segfaults in the inference path for quantized 4-bit models (gptx-4q-family).

ravi (eng-infra): `kubectl get pods -n infra -l app=runtime-engine -o wide` shows ~30 pods across gke-usw2-a100-{4,5,6}. CrashLoopBackOff primarily on a100-5. Node logs show repeated Xid 31 and then container exit code 139.

alejandra (oncall-sre): can someone paste a pod stderr?

devin (eng-runtime): pod runtime-engine-2d9c1 stderr: 
```
[2026-03-15T04:12:09Z] startup: loading model gptx-4q-v2
[2026-03-15T04:12:09Z] trt-chooser: selected fused_attention_int4.trt
[2026-03-15T04:12:10Z] cuda: cudaMemcpyAsync -> CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS (err=700)
*** Received signal 11 (Segmentation fault) ***\nBacktrace:\n  fused_attention_trt+0x88 (0x7f2d5c4b88)\n  kv_cache_write+0x2b1 (0x7f2d5c5a1)
```
Also seeing logs referencing `tensor-core-accelerated kernels built with compute capability 8.0` even though node has sm_8_6 driver mix.

ravi (eng-infra): checking node driver versions: a100-5 has NVIDIA driver 535.86, CUDA toolkit 12.3; a100-4/6 have 535.54. Possibly a driver/ptx mismatch causing illegal address in TRT kernel.

alejandra (oncall-sre): immediate mitigation options?

devin (eng-runtime): short-term: 1) Set env `DISABLE_TRT_FUSED_KERNELS=true` on the runtime deployment to force fallback to reference kernels. 2) If env set not possible fast enough, cordon the a100-5 node and move pods to other nodes.

ravi (eng-infra): I can patch the deployment env now. I'll also prepare a node cordon if we still see restarts.

deploy-bot: Executing: `kubectl set env deployment/runtime-engine DISABLE_TRT_FUSED_KERNELS=true -n infra`

deploy-bot: Rollout triggered for deployment/runtime-engine. Monitor: `kubectl rollout status deployment/runtime-engine -n infra`

devin (eng-runtime): new pods booting with DISABLE_TRT_FUSED_KERNELS=true. Sample log: 
```
[2026-03-15T04:16:22Z] trt-chooser: fused kernels disabled via env
[2026-03-15T04:16:23Z] runtime: loaded model gptx-4q-v2 (compat kernels)
[2026-03-15T04:16:25Z] health: ok
```
Crash rate falling.

ravi (eng-infra): cordoning a100-5 as backup plan: `kubectl cordon gke-usw2-a100-5` then `kubectl drain gke-usw2-a100-5 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data`. Starting drain now.

alejandra (oncall-sre): mika, can you run customer-facing checks and SLO impact calc?

mika (prod-sre): running synthetic gen tests across us-west2 region. Error rate for generation endpoints peaked at 6.2% between 04:10-04:18 UTC, now stabilized at 0.2% after mitigation. p95 increased briefly to 1.8s from baseline 1.1s while fallbacks were used. Flagging SLO hit: error budget consumed ~0.05%.

ellery (cs): notifying impacted customers in us-west2 sandbox orgs A and C. Sending mitigation note and short ETA for RCA.

alejandra (oncall-sre): good. what's the suspected root cause?

devin (eng-runtime): likely TensorRT fused kernel binary built targeting a PTX/SM set not fully compatible with minor driver variations (535.86 vs 535.54). The kernel triggers illegal memory access under certain quantized KV layouts. We'll reproduce on a dev box with driver 535.86 and TRT 8.x.

ravi (eng-infra): node a100-5 remains cordoned; drain completed and pods rescheduled to other nodes. No further restarts observed for last 6 minutes.

alejandra (oncall-sre): handover plan: I'll stay for 20 more minutes to confirm stability then hand to mika for post-incident monitoring and RCA coordination. Devin to own RCA and PR. Ellery to manage customer comms follow-up.

devin (eng-runtime): immediate follow-ups: PR to 1) add driver-compat checks in trt-chooser 2) build fallback with safe alignment checks for int4 KV writes 3) add CI repro with mixed driver matrix. Opening ticket INC-1780043210-RCA. PR coming shortly.

mika (prod-sre): I'll keep synthetic checks for 4h at 1m cadence. Alert thresholds: error rate >1% or crashloops reappear.

deploy-bot: Rollout completed: deployment/runtime-engine successfully rolled out (all pods ready).

incident-bot: Incident P1 -> P0 (mitigated). Owners assigned: Devin (eng-runtime) for RCA, Mika (prod-sre) for monitoring, Alejandra signoff on paging.

ellery (cs): initial customer messages sent. Will follow up after RCA with technical summary.

alejandra (oncall-sre): signing off active page. Thanks all. If issue resurfaces, re-ping oncall.

devin (eng-runtime): PR #4682: "trt-chooser: add driver compatibility guard & int4 KV alignment checks" created and linked to incident. Repro job queued on a100-standby with driver 535.86.

mika (prod-sre): adding timeline and logs to incident ticket and creating postmortem skeleton: https://internal.redwood/incident/1780043210/postmortem

incident-bot: Reminder: include customer impact, timeline, root cause, mitigations, follow-ups, and SLO impact in postmortem.

(End of thread)
